Each point is one school district, positioned by its library-system centroid and colored by that district's own local coefficient from a multiscale geographically weighted regression — not a single national number. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, hover a district for detail. Click a district to ring it and map its public library locations (diamonds are headquarters, squares are branches) — zoom in further to see them, and click the district again to clear the selection.
